desc: Prepare a dessert with the chocolatey fudge brownie taste you expect from Betty Crocker and 25% less sugar than our Supreme Chocolate Chunk Brownie Mix (Sugar content has been reduced from 18g to 12g per serving. No reduction in calories). Betty Crocker Lower Sugar Double Chocolate Fudge Brownie Mix makes it easy to create brownies with irresistible flavor and without artificial sweeteners. In just a few minutes, you can take this dry baking mix from the box to the oven. Simply add oil, water and eggs and bake according to package directions. Try topping cooled brownies with Betty Crocker Lower Sugar Frosting. Betty Crocker Lower Sugar Brownie Mix is ideal for a party, afternoon snack, or an anytime treat that can help you meet dietary needs. Keep a box in your pantry as a tasty addition to a lower sugar lifestyle. Betty’s got your back! For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
LOWER SUGAR: Brownie mix with 25% less sugar than our Supreme Chocolate Chunk Brownie Mix (Sugar content has been reduced from 18g to 12g per serving. No reduction in calories)

QUICK AND EASY: Goes from the box to the oven in minutes; Just stir this dry baking mix together with a few simple ingredients

TASTY OPTIONS: Use this mix to create family favorite desserts; Layer brownies in a chocolate trifle, make a brownie sundae, or top with Betty Crocker Lower Sugar Frosting

PANTRY STAPLE: Betty Crocker brings you trusted favorites you know and love such as brownie mixes, cake mixes, cookie mixes, and more

CONTAINS: One 14.7 oz box of Betty Crocker Lower Sugar Brownie Mix
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Soluble Corn Fiber, Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Salt, Artificial Flavor.
